comparison.objective: Unlock, remove, and lay down a wheelchair armrest; candidate adjusts a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring release while lifting two long posts squarely from sockets and controlling a 1.2 kg assembly versus two-tool countertorque and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: Both posts clear, armrest moved outward and laid safely on its side; dropping fails, with partial credit for release and extraction progress.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous latch release and parallel extraction are materially different from preserving a threaded angular adjustment while locking it.
